title: Seasonal subsurface salinity evolution in a Gulf subregion
query: Using daily GLORYS temperature and salinity from 6 August 2016 to 25 July 2017, examine the fixed central Gulf box 92–88 W, 23–27 N. Calculate the 50–300 m salinity maximum and its depth, a regional salinity time-depth diagram, and density-threshold mixed-layer depth relative to 10 m (0.03 kg m-3). Compare November–March with the remaining supplied months and test whether salinity-core changes accompany mixed-layer deepening. This is a fixed-region seasonal diagnostic, not Lagrangian tracking of the original glider eddy. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
